test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: The film "One Battle After Another," that won six Oscars in the 98th Academy Awards, held on March 15, 2026 was based on which novel by Thomas Pynchon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vineland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **"One Battle After Another" is an adaptation of Thomas Pynchon's novel "Vineland".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The adaptation earned the Best Adapted Screenplay award.
 
• Paul Thomas Anderson wrote the screenplay based on the book.
 
• The novel was written by the acclaimed author Thomas Pynchon.
 
• The film adaptation turned it into a political epic.
